design_philosophy.core_concept: Precision, Heat, and Layers. The UI should feel like a high-end machine interface.
design_philosophy.visual_metaphor: The 'Layered' Look - utilizing z-index and subtle borders to mimic 3D printing layers.

headings.usage: All section titles, page headers, and major stats. Use tracking-tight (-0.02em) for sizes above 24px.

mono.usage: Order IDs, G-code snippets, file sizes, timestamps, pricing breakdowns.

primary.description: Electric Orange - Represents heat and extrusion. Use for Primary CTAs and active states.

accent.usage: Blue for Info/Processing, Purple for Admin/System, Green for Success/Completed.

visual_enhancers.border_gradient: border border-transparent bg-gradient-to-b from-zinc-700 to-zinc-900 bg-clip-border

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.
layout.border_radius: rounded-lg (8px) for standard elements, rounded-xl (12px) for containers.

grid_strategy.admin_dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). Use col-span-2 for charts, col-span-1 for stats.
grid_strategy.client_gallery: Tetris Grid Mode A (Visual). Staggered card sizes for 3D models.

cards.style: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 rounded-md

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-orange-500 transition-all font-mono text-sm

status_badge.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract geometric neon lights - Use for Client Portal Hero background with overlay.
Purple/Black 3D printer close up - Use for Login/Auth pages.

placeholders.description: Resin Printer printing - Use for 'New Order' or 'Services' card.
Abstract Clock/Time - Use for 'History' or 'Timeline' sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: First, install missing 3D deps: `yarn add three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei framer-motion`.
2. THEME OVERRIDE: Go to `index.css` and strictly replace the `.dark` layer colors with the 'Zinc + Orange' palette defined in 'colors' section. Do not use the default slate colors.
4. 3D VIEWER: Create a generic `<STLViewer url={...} />` component using React Three Fiber. Use `<Stage>` from 'drei' for instant good lighting.
5. DASHBOARD LAYOUT: Create a reusable `DashboardShell` component with a sidebar (glassmorphism) and a main content area (with the grid background pattern).
6. STATUS PILLS: Create a mapped object for status colors. Pending=Yellow, Printing=Blue, Done=Green. Use `Badge` component from shadcn but styled with `border` and transparent bg.
7. FILE UPLOAD: The file upload area must be a 'Dropzone' that accepts .stl and .obj. Design it with a dashed orange border on hover.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure 3D viewer has a fallback/loading state.
Dark mode is mandatory. Do not build light mode unless requested.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
